name: VRferapy Home - Fear2Drive
summary:
This is not a game! Fear2Drive helps people with phobias self-train and improve their mental health issues related to their fear of driving (the app uses auto-driving mode). Fear2Drive includes different vehicle types and scenarios, such as urban streets in Mainland China and Hong Kong China, private cars, trucks and motorcycles, etc.
